observations.craft_sdk: Six planks/four sticks filled the five ingredient positions for two wooden pickaxes in the actual 3x3 grid. Ordinary click delivered one pickaxe. SDK close returned three planks/two sticks; read-only counts confirmed these and two total pickaxes (one existed before this exact run).

observations.craft_alias_shift: /workbench opened the native 3x3 screen. Shift-click consumed the remaining three planks/two sticks and delivered one pickaxe. Counts: zero planks, zero sticks, three total pickaxes. Client Escape closed the provider-owned alias ticket.
observations.stonecutter_regression: One stone became one stone brick using selection and Shift-click. Counts: no stone, two stone bricks including one that existed before the run.
observations.inventory2x2_regression: Opened real inventory with previously equipped helmet/shield visible. SDK closure returned zero tickets while real inventory remained open until Escape. No item transfer through this entry in this run.
observations.form_regression: SDK form button dispatched exactly one consumer callback and returned to zero outstanding tickets.

counter_limit: The workbench alias is a separate provider-owned ticket and is not counted by the NativePassthrough example. Zero SDK failures is not a native transaction certificate.
